title: Electrification dominates corporate green capex, says EU platform
lede: Over half of taxonomy-aligned capex was spent on clean energy infrastructure in 2025, finds EU Platform on Sustainable Finance.

title: Ukrainians evacuate soldier using heavy air drone after he spent 500 days at the front, in another first-ever in the war, (Ukraine Battlefield update, day 1,699)
lede: While US secretary of state Marco Rubio publicly echoes Vladimir Putin’s inflated claims about Russian gains in Donetsk, Ukrainian crews on the ground are using scarce drones to snatch back their own wounded from territory Moscow says it controls.
